summary: Implemented Codex-only project convention injection by adding optional projectConventions plumbing in cli-worker and cli-runner. Codex prompt assembly now prepends a PROJECT CONVENTIONS (from CLAUDE.md) block before WORKER_CONTEXT when provided, while Claude Code path remains unchanged. CliTaskRunner now reads <workingDir>/CLAUDE.md only for codex backend with graceful missing-file handling. Added tests in cli-worker.test.ts for codex prepend/empty behavior and Claude non-injection, plus new cli-runner.test.ts verifying codex receives CLAUDE.md content, missing file yields undefined, and claude_code does not receive projectConventions. Verified with pnpm build, pnpm vitest run src/goal/, pnpm lint, and node scripts/run-node.mjs goal --help.
